title: Probe into Network Hardware Issues that Caused System Outage at Polyclinics on 27 August 2022
what_it_is: Probe into Network Hardware Issues that Caused System Outage at Polyclinics on 27 August 2022

sections.label: Questions on healthcare IT outage
sections.summary: Questions asked the Minister for Health about the 27 August 2022 network hardware issues, IHiS budget and capabilities, and safeguards against future disruptions.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Health in respect of network hardware issues affecting the IT systems of public healthcare institutions on 27 August 2022 (a) whether a cyber attack has been ruled out; (b) what are the root causes of the outage; (c) whether existing redundancy measures are sufficient to maintain provision of healthcare services; (d) what lessons have been learned; and (e) what is being done to improve resilience against such incidents.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Health (a) what are the budget, headcount and deliverables of the Integrated Health Information Systems (IHiS); (b) how do these benchmark against best-in-class international healthcare institutions and top technology-sector firms; and (c) what is being done to strengthen the capabilities of IHiS systems, processes and staff.

sentences.speaker: Dr Wan Rizal
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Health with regard to the network hardware issues that caused a system outage at some polyclinics on 27 August 2022, what are the safeguards in place or that will be implemented to prevent disruptions in the future.

sections.label: IT applications affected
sections.summary: 26 IT applications were affected, including electronic medical records, appointment, pharmacy and laboratory systems.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: In total, 26 IT applications were affected, including the electronic medical records, appointment, pharmacy and laboratory systems.

sections.label: Patient wait times
sections.summary: Patients at affected institutions experienced longer wait times of up to one hour.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Patients experienced longer wait times ranging up to one hour at the affected institutions.

sections.label: Cause of outages
sections.summary: The main cause of the outages were failures of hardware devices in data centres.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: The main cause of the outages were failures of hardware devices in our data centres.

sections.label: Benchmarking and service agreements
sections.summary: IHiS takes reference from technology and healthcare technology industries, with service level agreements on uptime and usability benchmarked against best-in-class worldwide, and bugs not previously described elsewhere.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: We do indeed take reference from other parts of the technology industry and healthcare technology industry.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: There are service level agreements about the uptime availability, as well as the user interface usability for the products that IHiS manages and these are indeed benchmarked against best-in-class around the world.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: The bugs that we have detected as part of these incidents have not previously been described before in other parts of the world.

sections.label: Business continuity drills
sections.summary: Business continuity and disaster recovery plans are drilled regularly in healthcare units and teams.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Yes, business continuity plans, disaster recovery plans, are drilled regularly in the healthcare units and teams.
